summary: The diff implements most requirements including enhanced login button visibility, book preferences, sample books, sell feature, menu dropdown, voice search, camera capture, and Kolkata address. However, some acceptance criteria are partially implemented or have technical gaps.

missing_requirements.requirement: Camera icon button should allow image-based book identification with uploaded images processed and associated with search actions
missing_requirements.reason: Camera capture component exists for sell book form but is not integrated into search functionality for image-based book identification

missing_requirements.requirement: Genre preferences should be stored in user profile
missing_requirements.reason: BookPreferences are stored separately from UserProfile in the backend, not as part of the user profile structure as specified
